title: Terms of sale and website use
html:
Effective 2026-11-18. Fitzgerald Enterprises LLC, a limited liability company formed in MI, operates Fernwork at fernwork.zeabur.app. When you place an order directly on this website, this company is your seller. For help, email PumpCadle668@outlook.com or call (269) 240-6135.

What you are buying

The listing identifies the product, selected variant, quantity, included items and price. Check the measurements for the variant you select. Houseplants are living goods and vary in leaf count and shape; the images show the size class you receive.

Placing an order

Review your items, delivery address and total before you pay. Prices and charges are in US dollars. Checkout identifies shipping and applicable sales tax we collect. We acknowledge receipt by an on-screen confirmation and accept the order when the confirmation is issued. If we discover a pricing or stock error we will contact you, explain your options and obtain your agreement before charging a different price. We refund payments for goods we cannot supply.

Shipping, returns and problems

An ordinary order is a one-time purchase. Our Shipping and delivery, Returns, refunds and order cancellations, and Payments and billing pages explain when goods ship, who pays return costs, how to request a refund and how charges appear on your statement.

Using the store

You confirm you are at least the age of majority where you live. You agree not to use the store unlawfully or in a way that harms it. We may decline an order or limit quantities where an item is unavailable or fraud is suspected.

Intellectual property and imagery

The text, images, logos and designs on this site belong to Fitzgerald Enterprises LLC or its licensors. Images are digital renderings; colours, textures and proportions may differ from the physical goods. See the Legal notice.

Liability and law

The store and products are provided "as is" and "as available". To the fullest extent permitted by law Fitzgerald Enterprises LLC is not liable for indirect or consequential loss. Nothing here limits rights you have under consumer law. These terms are governed by the laws of MI, USA.

Complaints and changes

Send your order number and the problem to PumpCadle668@outlook.com or 36 W Michigan Ave, Battle Creek, MI 49017, USA. The terms in effect when you ordered apply to that purchase. We may update these terms; the latest version is always on this page.
